efficiency_choices: Do not rerun the 3.71-hour oracle or the 3200-row reward replay.
Do not combine the servers into a 32-device SFT job; the data is too small and cross-machine collectives would increase setup and synchronization cost.
Use the training-compatible Step 120 checkpoint path that needs the least conversion; do not add a new LoRA stack unless it is already loadable by the existing trainer.
Stop automatically after the 16-example replay gate or the correction-SFT dev20 gate fails.
Keep test20 sealed and skip it unless the development gates pass.

uncertainty.main_unknown: The repository has no existing supervised-finetuning launcher, so the first clean SFT load/backward path is the largest schedule risk.
uncertainty.likely_range: 12-16 hours for the full gated path
uncertainty.downside_case: 18-24 hours if the first SFT attempt exposes a checkpoint-format or Megatron data-loader incompatibility
uncertainty.not_a_commitment: The ranges assume both project containers and the Step 120 checkpoint remain healthy and available.
